samples.selection: The sample covers the two Bare lip kit formulas already in the archive and the original full-size black Kylash mascara, selected before checking its price. Each comparison covers one item shipped to an Oregon street address by Kylie Cosmetics or Ulta. Missing observations stay in the coverage count.

records.name: Sony WF-1000XM6
records.variant: Platinum Silver · WF1000XM6S.CE7 · one new pair with charging case
records.matchNote: The original ad identifies the WF-1000XM6. Its caption leaves the colour, seller and price unspecified. These two shops list the same Platinum Silver UK model. The comparison uses the manufacturer's store as the reference.

reference.note: The silver UK model was orderable at £199 including VAT. One pair qualifies for free standard delivery. Optional timed delivery and membership offers are excluded.

records.name: Kylie Cosmetics Matte Lip Kit
